items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 90:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Nukva at the height of her growth? The height of the growth of the Nukva is the seventh discernment, that she serves with him face to face in one crown. And this will not be until the future. As said above in Answer 6, see there. (Item 5 and 6).
